preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 2^16 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= degree_v <= n - 1 for degree_v, _ in degrees_and_s)
preconditions.description: Each degree_v is a non-negative integer less than n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= s_v < 2**16 for _, s_v in degrees_and_s)
preconditions.description: Each s_v is a non-negative integer less than 2^16.
The sum of all degrees is even (since it equals twice the number of edges).

postconditions.expression: m == sum(degree_v for degree_v, _ in degrees_and_s) // 2
postconditions.description: The number of edges m is exactly half the sum of all degrees.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= a < n and 0 <= b < n and a != b for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge consists of two distinct vertices within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(degree_v == len([b for a, b in edges if a == v or b == v]) for v, (degree_v, _) in enumerate(degrees_and_s))
postconditions.description: The degree of each vertex v matches the number of edges incident to it.

postconditions.expression: all(s_v == sum(degree_u for u in neighbors if u != v) ^ sum(degree_u for u in neighbors if u != v) for v, (degree_v, s_v) in enumerate(degrees_and_s) if degree_v > 0)
postconditions.description: For each vertex v with degree > 0, the XOR sum s_v equals the XOR of the degrees of its neighbors.
The number of edges printed matches the computed m.
